welcome.heading: Fictional button-board activity
welcome.goal: Decide where the evidence supports placing each fictional new function.
welcome.open_book: You do not need to memorize rules. The card and “How to think” checklist stay visible.
welcome.card_only: Use only the page record; do not add everyday experience.
welcome.privacy: No name, contact detail, or free text is requested. The server creates a random internal attempt ID.

tutorial.heading: One core idea
tutorial.intuition: A button responding does not mean it meets the stated goal more often than the existing method.

demonstration.heading: Worked example
demonstration.intro: This fictional example is separate from every formal scenario. The card stays visible while one worked question is revealed at a time.

formal_intro.heading: Formal scenarios
formal_intro.guard: Use only the record shown. Do not add information from the item name, everyday knowledge, or personal preference.
formal_intro.feedback: Formal trials do not show correctness. Any of the four destinations may apply.

labels.result: Based on your answers, place it in:

attention.heading: Read-the-instruction check
attention.instruction: This item only checks whether you read the instruction. For the first question, select “Shows or reports the current condition.”

reflection.heading: Optional structured reflection
reflection.hardest: Which step was hardest to read?
reflection.confusing: Which destinations were easiest to confuse?
reflection.amount: How was the amount of page text?

confusing.text: Leave it off and Check again

export.heading: Activity complete
export.debrief: You did not test real products. This activity records how you apply evidence thresholds to fictional cards; it does not measure real-world benefit.
export.manual: Downloads are manual. No score is shown.

save_exit.heading: End this local activity?
save_exit.body: The session cannot resume. Submitted choices will be frozen in a signed partial export; nothing downloads automatically.

checklist: Does it show a condition, or perform an action intended to change the target outcome?
Were both methods compared under the stated matched conditions?
With equal denominators, did the new method meet the goal more often?
Did it impair another explicitly stated important outcome?
Are all required scope dimensions stated?
Does the “Only when…” label match every recorded dimension?

1.prompt: Does the new item show a condition, or perform an action intended to change the stated target outcome?

options.text: Shows or reports the current condition
Performs an action intended to change the outcome

2.prompt: Did the card test both methods for the stated number of rounds under the listed matched conditions?

options.text: Both methods were tested as stated
No / the card does not show that

3.prompt: Using only the defined goal and equal denominators, did the new item meet the goal more often, or equally/less often?

options.text: The new item met the goal more often
The count was equal or lower

4.prompt: While using the new item, did another explicitly stated important outcome become impaired?

options.text: Yes, the stated other outcome was impaired
No stated impairment occurred

5.prompt: Does every required scope dimension have a concrete recorded value?

options.text: Every required dimension has a value
At least one required value is unstated

6.prompt: Which “Only when…” label matches the card dimension by dimension? Every option is equally detailed; do not invent unstated conditions.

card.situation: Retrieve a pair of socks in a specified color from a divided drawer.
card.goal: “Correct within 20 seconds” means both socks match the specified color.
card.existing: Read the front color labels, then search one compartment at a time.
card.new_item: Pressing the matching color button moves one possible compartment to the front.
facts: The new button moved one compartment to the front in 10/10 rounds.
The 10 paired rounds used the same drawer contents, sock placement, target color, and 20-second limit; method order or side alternated.
The original method and new button each had 10 rounds.
The original method met the target in 8/10 rounds; the new button did so in 6/10.
A sock was caught by a compartment edge in 0/10 rounds; A sock left the drawer in 0/10 rounds.
Recorded scope | drawer=this trial drawer | labels=current six color labels | operator=self only.

options.text: Shows or reports the current condition
Performs an action intended to change the outcome

evidence: The new button moved one compartment to the front in 10/10 rounds.
worked_steps.why: The button moves a compartment, so it performs an action rather than only reporting a condition.

options.text: Both methods were tested as stated

evidence: The 10 paired rounds used the same drawer contents, sock placement, target color, and 20-second limit; method order or side alternated.
The original method and new button each had 10 rounds.
worked_steps.why: The record says the rounds were paired under the same listed conditions and both methods had ten rounds.

worked_steps.question: Using only the defined goal and equal denominators, did the new item meet the goal more often, or equally/less often?

options.text: The new item met the goal more often
The count was equal or lower

evidence: The original method met the target in 8/10 rounds; the new button did so in 6/10.
worked_steps.why: The new button met the target in 6/10 rounds, fewer than the original method's 8/10.

destination.label: Leave it off
destination.description: Do not place it on this button board.

demonstration.why: The button reacted every time, but it did not beat the existing method on the stated target. A response alone is not enough.

tutorial.heading: 一条核心直觉

F3.title: 阅读时关闭三个应用通知的按钮

card.situation: 晚上在手机上连续阅读 20 分钟。
card.goal: 20 分钟内，屏幕不出现三个指定普通应用的弹窗。
card.existing: 阅读前逐个关闭这三个应用的通知。
card.new_item: 按一次按钮，会同时修改这三个应用的通知设置。
facts: 新按钮在 10/10 轮中都写入了三个应用的设置。
共 10 个配对轮；每轮的保存文章、应用初始设置、Wi‑Fi、20 分钟时限和测试来电分钟点相同，做法顺序或左右位置轮换。
原办法和新按钮各做 10 轮。
原办法 6/10 轮达到目标；新按钮 9/10 轮达到目标。
这条记录指定的测试联系人来电，在 3/10 轮中既没有铃声，也没有屏幕提示。
试用前，这条记录已说明：该测试联系人按安排打来时，必须出现铃声或屏幕提示。

card.situation: 雨后处理鞋内一块标记区域的潮湿鞋垫。
card.goal: 30 分钟后，用新白纸巾按压标记区域 5 秒，纸巾上没有可见水印。
card.existing: 取出鞋垫，在桌面风扇前吹 30 分钟。
card.new_item: 按下按钮后，向标记区域送风 30 分钟。
facts: 新按钮在 10/10 轮中都送风 30 分钟。
记录表分别列出“原办法”和“新按钮”两栏。
“原办法”栏是 0 轮；“新按钮”栏是 10 轮，没有任何一轮使用原办法。
新按钮 8/10 轮达到纸巾标准。
两张过程照片也都来自新按钮轮次，分别拍摄于第 0 分钟和第 30 分钟。

card.situation: 穿衣前减少衣物贴在手臂上的静电。
card.goal: 穿上后 1 分钟，一张平直纸片能从袖子与裸露手臂之间穿过。
card.existing: 用微湿棉布在衣物内侧擦一次。
card.new_item: 把装置固定在衣物上后，按下按钮会在固定位置释放一次脉冲。
facts: 新按钮在 12/12 轮中都释放了一次脉冲。
共 12 个配对轮；每轮的材质、衣物类型、预处理、摆放、穿着方式和测试时间相互匹配，做法顺序或左右位置轮换。
原办法和新按钮各做 12 轮。
原办法 7/12 轮达到目标；新按钮 10/12 轮达到目标。

card.situation: 洗漱后看清浴室镜面中央的标记区域。
card.goal: 启动后 60 秒内，从 1 米外读出标记区域后的四个 12 mm 字符，并在第 5 分钟仍能全部读出。
card.existing: 用干燥超细纤维布擦一次标记区域。
card.new_item: 按下按钮后，向标记区域送风 5 分钟。
facts: 新按钮在 14/14 轮中都送风 5 分钟。
共 14 个配对轮；每轮的镜面、中央 20×20 cm 区域、字符、38–40°C 用水、起始雾化步骤、排风扇关闭状态和计时点相同，做法顺序或左右位置轮换。
原办法和新按钮各做 14 轮。
原办法 8/14 轮达到目标；新按钮 13/14 轮达到目标。
水痕 0/14；镜框移动 0/14；字符被遮住 0/14。
